input_allowance_method: Conservative UTF-8 byte count plus existing instruction/serialization overhead; not tokenizer measurement.
conditions: Verify a selected model and its current prices, confirm estimate is within cap, and obtain explicit spending authorization before enabling. No automatic retries. Existing locked reservation ledger and exact numerical/citation checks remain mandatory.
acceptance: At most ten structured outputs; prioritize growth/profit conversion, operating drivers, funding/credit risk and dividend chronology. Every factual statement must have supplied evidence; unsupported causal interpretations fail human review. No semantic-verification claim.
